note: Measured from committed meme boards and the meme journal before the early-entry sleeve existed. These figures were not used to choose the early-entry thresholds. Pair age on a board is the ageMin the snapshot stored. Entry age is openedAt minus the median of (fetchedAt - ageMin) across boards that stored an age for that mint. A backfill that produced a negative age was not used in the distribution.

firstSight.source: ageMin on the first committed board that contained the mint

snapshotGapMin.note: Minutes between committed meme boards. This is the realistic detection latency of the Kalshi chain. GitHub cron cannot run faster than 5 minutes and the 5-minute kick has been dropped.

entryAgeMin.note: Every paper entry is at least 30 minutes old. That is the v9 age floor, not a discovery delay. The minimum in this file is 30.0 minutes.

winners.note: First board had no ageMin. Age is backfilled from later boards. Public 5-minute candles do not reach pool creation (2026-11-15). No launch fraction.

18% of the move from the first GeckoTerminal 5-minute open to the high before our exit was already in the candle when the desk first logged the coin. 75% of the later logged rally, from that first price to the peak, happened before the paper entry. We saw it at 8 minutes and entered at 333.

The candle path says 5% of the launch-to-peak move was in before the first sight candle. The desk's own first price was higher than that candle, and the board already showed +704% on the 1h change at 6 minutes old. 66% of the logged rally after that first price happened before entry.
17% of the launch-to-peak move was in the candle at first sight. The board's 1h change was already +147%. 19% of the logged rally after the first price happened before entry.

About 1% of the launch-to-peak move had happened when we first logged it. The 1h change on that board was +4%. Then the price ran +306% before the paper entry. We were late to enter, not late to see it.

Entered on the first board, at the 30 minute floor. 57% of the launch-to-peak move was already in the sight candle. The board's 1h change was +325%. None of the post-sight rally was missed before entry.

candleSource: GeckoTerminal pool ohlcv, 5-minute bars, fetched 2026-11-20. Launch is the open of the oldest bar only when that bar starts within 20 minutes of pool_created_at. Sight is the 5-minute close at or before the first board time. Peak is the max high through the paper exit. shareOfMoveBeforeSight = (sight - launch) / (peak - launch). HOGE is excluded because the oldest bar is about 2 days after creation.
